summary: Iteration-9 full-stack test of Saved Looks feature. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass covering GET/POST/PUT/DELETE /api/appearance/{display}/looks and POST /{display}/looks/{id}/apply — 401 without settings token, 404 for unknown look id, 409 case-insensitive duplicate name, 422 for empty name and >60 char name, create snapshots current display image, update overwrites settings + current image (and releases prior if orphan), apply replaces display settings + image_id + active_look_id, list returns active_look_id, delete clears active_look_id when it was the applied look. Church name 'Providence Baptist Church' and logo image id (6ac910d39b313758ba6d7f61) verified unchanged throughout. Image safety verified: applying a saved look restores its image (and the look's image is retained even when the display's current image changes), and deleting a look does NOT delete the image if it is still shown on the display (verified via GET /api/appearance/image/{id} 200). Frontend (/settings-admin, PIN 1234): looks-panel renders on both Bible and Register tabs with look-name-input + look-save-btn (disabled when empty), creating a look populates looks-list with look-row-{name} + Swatches; case-insensitive duplicate ('test_uilook' vs 'TEST_UIlook') produces 409 and a sonner error toast 'A look named ... already exists. Use Update on it instead.'; look-apply-{name} applies and look-active-{name} 'On screen' badge appears; look-delete-{name} opens delete-look-dialog with delete-look-confirm which removes the row and shows success toast.
action_items: CRITICAL / ACKNOWLEDGE WITH USER: The user's original bible background image (id 6ac910fe9b313758ba6d7f62) was lost during the first run of this iteration's test file due to a test-harness race (two pytest-xdist workers running my module-scoped cleanup fixture before TestLooksFlow's upload step; the parallel teardown deleted the TEST_Original look, so when the subsequent upload called release_image(old_bible_image) the image had no remaining reference and was deleted). The product code (release_image + looks apply/delete flows) is NOT at fault — a clean serial re-run (and the re-structured single-class test on xdist) shows image-safety works. The test file was fixed (TestAuth merged into TestLooksFlow so loadscope keeps it on one worker). At the end of testing the bible display's image was cleared (image_url=null) so the UI does not render a broken image; all other bible appearance settings (panel_opacity=0, image_blur=20, image_dim=70, church_name_position=bottom-center, church_name_size=4, church_logo_size=4, translation_show=false, etc.) are preserved, as are the church name, logo image, and the register background image (6ac911b79b313758ba6d7f67). Main agent should ask the user to re-upload a bible background image if they want one.
Harden release_image further: already correct (checks display_appearance / display_looks / site_settings refs); no change needed.
critical_code_review_comments: looks_routes.py — clean small module, correctly uses SETTINGS_AUTH on all mutating routes; Literal['register','bible'] prevents path spoofing; name trim + case-insensitive duplicate check with regex-escaped input; name length enforced by Pydantic (1..60).
appearance.release_image — correct 3-source reference check (display_appearance.image_id, display_looks.image_id, site_settings.logo_image_id) using short-circuited `or`; no change needed.
apply_look sets active_look_id and only releases the old display image if it is actually different from the look's image_id — correct.
update_look releases the look's old image_id after replacing it with the current display image_id — correct; prevents orphaned images when a look is updated.
delete_look clears display_appearance.active_look_id when it points at the deleted look (atomic single update filtered by active_look_id==look_id) — correct.

LooksPanel.jsx — testids present for all required elements (looks-panel, look-name-input, look-save-btn, looks-list, look-row-{name}, look-apply-{name}, look-update-{name}, look-delete-{name}, look-active-{name}, delete-look-dialog, delete-look-cancel, delete-look-confirm); keyboard Enter saves; busy state guards double-submit; Swatches preview covers bg/text/accent + current image thumbnail.
AppearanceEditor passes settings via Object.fromEntries(KEYS...) so unsaved form edits are captured in the saved look — matches spec.
Minor: LooksPanel error toasts use errMsg(e) uniformly; no silent failures.

success_rate.backend: 100% (15/15, 2 skipped only because the bible display's image is now null)

seed_data_creation: Transient TEST_ prefixed looks created and deleted during the run (nothing left behind in db.display_looks). One tiny 69-byte test PNG was uploaded to the bible display during the image-safety test and then deleted via DELETE /api/appearance/bible/image at the end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope. Module-scoped cleanup fixtures CAN run twice (once per worker) if your test classes get distributed to different workers — this ran my earlier teardown prematurely and nuked a real user image. Keep stateful end-to-end flows in a SINGLE test class so loadscope pins them to one worker. The user's bible background image is now empty (image_url=null); other bible appearance custom values (panel_opacity=0, image_blur=20, image_dim=70, bottom-center church name, logo_size=4, translation_show=false, church_name_position=bottom-center) are preserved. Register display image + logo + church name untouched. Saved Looks endpoints exist for both /register and /bible — same code path.
rca of the issue: No product bugs. Harness RCA: pytest-xdist with --dist loadscope grouped TestAuth and TestLooksFlow onto DIFFERENT workers; the module-scoped autouse cleanup fixture therefore ran once per worker. gw1 (TestAuth) finished its two 401 checks within ~1s, then ran module teardown: it listed all TEST_ looks and DELETEd them — including the TEST_Original look gw0 had just created with image_id = user's real bible image. With that look gone, when gw0 later uploaded a replacement image and release_image(old) ran, old had no remaining reference and was deleted. Fix applied: merged auth tests into TestLooksFlow (single class) so loadscope keeps the whole module on one worker; subsequent runs are clean (15 pass, 2 skipped because the image slot is now empty).
